qa_pairs.question: What is the deadline for projects to migrate their cloud resources from the legacy Arbutus Cloud to the new Arbutus Cloud?
qa_pairs.answer: The deadline for both RAS and RAC projects to migrate to the new Arbutus Cloud is August 31, 2026.

qa_pairs.question: Why is it necessary to migrate cloud resources from the legacy Arbutus Cloud to the new Arbutus Cloud?
qa_pairs.answer: Migration is necessary for all cloud resources currently on the legacy Arbutus Cloud because it will be decommissioned in 2026.

qa_pairs.question: What key information should research teams gather when planning their cloud migration from the legacy Arbutus Cloud?
qa_pairs.answer: When planning your cloud migration, you should identify which resources need migration, whether instances are ephemeral or volume-backed, any volumes over 150 GB (as they should be migrated using Globus), if automated deployment systems were used (and plan to use them again), and if custom DNS entries exist which will need updating.
